forecasts.q: A full ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, signed by both sides, takes effect
Trilateral technical-level talks among the United States, Russia, and Ukraine actually take place (at any venue)
A U.S.-Iran ceasefire takes effect and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz is officially announced

forecasts.s: U.S. resumes strikes on mainland Iran
forecasts.q: The United States officially announces the resumption of large-scale airstrikes on mainland Iran
Trump and Kim Jong Un hold a summit
North Korea conducts its seventh nuclear test
China conducts a named, large-scale joint exercise encircling Taiwan

forecasts.s: Second Thomas Shoal resupply blocked again
forecasts.q: A new incident in which China blocks a resupply mission to Second Thomas Shoal is publicly reported
Indian and Pakistani forces engage in interstate fighting that causes casualties
Pakistan and the Afghan Taliban agree to a formal ceasefire
The U.S.-China tariff truce is extended again before it expires or is replaced by a comprehensive agreement
Prime Minister Takaichi and President Xi Jinping hold a China-Japan summit
Brent crude's final closing price of the year is below $90 a barrel

forecasts.s: No inter-Korean provisions in a U.S.-North Korean deal
forecasts.q: If a U.S.-North Korean summit takes place without South Korea formally taking part in the preparatory negotiations, the resulting agreement will contain no provisions on inter-Korean relations or on medium- and short-range missiles
If the current trend (A0) continues, inter-Korean military communication lines will not be restored
If the current trend (A0) continues, family reunions and confirmations of whether relatives are alive will not resume
China will not retaliate with open, large-scale economic measures, as it did over THAAD, against South Korea's pursuit of enrichment, reprocessing, and nuclear-powered submarines
By the end of 2028, inter-Korean family reunions or large-scale confirmations of whether relatives are alive take place at least once

forecasts.s: South Korea or Japan formally goes nuclear
forecasts.q: By the end of 2030, South Korea or Japan formalizes one of the following: a decision to develop nuclear weapons, withdrawal from the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT), or abandonment of its non-nuclear principles

forecasts.s: North Korean leadership change or armed clash
forecasts.q: By the end of 2030, North Korea's supreme leader changes, or an armed clash on the Korean Peninsula kills 100 or more people

forecasts.s: U.S.-North Korean deal, inter-Korean ties still cut
forecasts.q: By the end of 2030, the United States and North Korea agree on a nuclear and missile freeze or on sanctions relief, but inter-Korean military communication lines and exchanges of separated families do not resume

forecasts.s: Trump-Kim meeting in first half of 2027
forecasts.q: Trump and Kim Jong Un meet by the end of June 2027

forecasts.s: North Korea-China trade holds at 2025 level
forecasts.q: North Korea-China trade for calendar year 2027 (Chinese customs statistics) stays at or above its 2025 level

forecasts.s: China inspects or detains Taiwan-linked ships
forecasts.q: By the end of 2027, a case is confirmed in which China's coast guard or maritime authorities inspect or detain a Taiwanese ship or a ship bound for Taiwan, or enforce navigation permits
The KMT candidate wins Taiwan's presidential election in January 2028

forecasts.s: Joint document on USFK operations beyond the peninsula
forecasts.q: By the end of June 2027, Seoul and Washington issue a joint document setting out consultation procedures for the use of USFK beyond the peninsula

forecasts.s: Chinese economic measures against South Korea over Taiwan
forecasts.q: By the end of 2027, China takes a formal economic measure against South Korea over Taiwan (export controls, an import halt, or a travel advisory)
A full ceasefire signed by both Russia and Ukraine holds for at least 30 days by the end of June 2027
By the end of 2027, the Ukrainian government signs a document recognizing the legal cession of occupied territory
By the end of 2027, troops of the multinational force (MNF-U) are deployed on Ukrainian territory

forecasts.s: Cheonghae Unit's area extended to Hormuz
forecasts.q: By the end of June 2027, the Cheonghae Unit's area of operations is formally extended to the vicinity of the Strait of Hormuz
The Middle East's share of South Korea's crude oil imports for the full year 2027 falls below 60 percent
By the end of 2027, Iran conducts a nuclear test or officially declares that it possesses nuclear weapons

forecasts.s: Four-party talks: U.S., China, two Koreas
forecasts.q: By the end of 2027, talks on the Korean Peninsula with all four countries (the United States, China, South Korea, and North Korea) taking part are held at least once
By the end of 2027, Russia publicly accepts the deployment in Ukraine of armed troops from non-NATO third countries (peacekeepers)
China does not impose an actual blockade (lasting seven days or more) on Taiwanese ports before Taiwan's presidential election in January 2028

forecasts.s: No Iranian attack on or seizure of Korean ships
forecasts.q: By the end of June 2027, no South Korean-flagged or South Korean-operated vessel is attacked or seized in an incident that the South Korean government or the shipping company officially attributes to Iran
By the end of March 2027, the United States and Iran sign an agreement that puts reopening the strait and lifting the blockade first and defers the nuclear issue to a later stage

forecasts.s: U.S.-China tariff truce and rare-earth pause extended
forecasts.q: By January 10, 2027, the United States and China again extend both the tariff truce and China's suspension of its rare-earth export controls, or replace them with a longer-term agreement

forecasts.s: H200 exports to China revoked or cut
forecasts.q: By the end of 2027, the United States formally revokes its approval of H200-class AI chip exports to China, or lowers the approved volume through regulation, license conditions, or legislation (a de facto halt resulting from Chinese import restrictions or a company's production stoppage does not count)

forecasts.s: North Korea states AI use in nuclear command
forecasts.q: By the end of 2027, North Korea states explicitly in its official media that it has applied AI or automation technology to the Nuclear Trigger (the state's comprehensive nuclear weapons management system) or to its nuclear counterattack command system

By the end of March 2027, a phased U.S.-Iran agreement (one that puts reopening the strait and lifting the blockade first and defers the nuclear issue to a later stage) is signed, and for at least 90 days after signing the strait stays open and the blockade stays lifted

forecasts.s: China Coast Guard controls around Kinmen and Matsu
forecasts.q: Before Taiwan's January 2028 election, the China Coast Guard sustains boarding inspections of vessels or navigation controls in the waters of outlying islands such as Kinmen and Matsu for seven days or more
By the end of June 2027, a major South Korean chipmaker officially announces a production cut or disruption due to a helium shortage, or such a disruption is reported by major media

forecasts.s: U.S. licenses for Samsung and SK China plants
forecasts.q: By January 31, 2027, a company or government announcement, or a report by Reuters, Bloomberg, or Yonhap, confirms that the United States has issued, for each of Samsung's Xi'an plant and SK hynix's Wuxi and Dalian plants, an equipment import license valid for at least six months of 2027 (annual licenses, multiyear licenses, and restoration of VEU status all count)

By December 31, 2026, the U.S. president signs a Section 232 proclamation that directly includes memory integrated circuits (HTS 8542.32) among the products subject to tariffs (resolves yes if they are among the covered products even with investment-linked exemptions or quotas attached; resolves no if only finished products containing memory are covered)

forecasts.s: Samsung or SK decides on a U.S. memory fab
forecasts.q: By June 30, 2027, Samsung Electronics or SK hynix announces a decision to build a memory wafer fab in the United States (excluding packaging and foundry) in a regulatory filing or press release that specifies the site or the investment amount (conditional reviews, memorandums of understanding, and reports that a plan is under consideration do not count)

By June 30, 2027, China's Ministry of Commerce newly places a South Korean company, or a subsidiary at least 50 percent owned by a South Korean company, on the export control list, the Unreliable Entity List, the countermeasure list under the Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law, or a list under State Council Decree No. 835; or the suspension of sanctions on Hanwha Ocean's subsidiaries is not extended and the sanctions take effect again (excluded if the lapse is merely a technical gap and the suspension is renewed within 30 days)

As of January 15, 2027, Ministry of Commerce Announcements Nos. 55–58, 61, and 62 of 2025 (the October 2025 expansion of rare-earth export controls) remain suspended or have been withdrawn (as confirmed by a Ministry of Commerce announcement or a joint U.S.-China announcement)

By March 31, 2027, volume-production shipments of HBM3 or HBM3E by CXMT (excluding samples, risk production, and units for qualification testing) are confirmed by an official CXMT announcement or by reports from at least two of Reuters, Bloomberg, TrendForce, and DigiTimes
In any quarter of 2027, CXMT's share of global DRAM revenue is reported at 15 percent or higher (by Counterpoint or TrendForce)

forecasts.s: U.S. legislation on chip controls for China
forecasts.q: By January 3, 2027 (the end of the 119th Congress), a law (a stand-alone bill or the National Defense Authorization Act) is enacted with the president's signature that contains at least one of the following: a provision banning sales of equipment and services to designated companies such as CXMT and YMTC, or a provision mandating U.S. extraterritorial controls if allies do not align by a deadline

forecasts.s: SCM communiqué states USFK troop level
forecasts.q: The joint communiqué of the November 2026 Security Consultative Meeting (SCM) explicitly states that USFK will be maintained at 28,500 troops
By the end of 2030, the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) is completed and the Future Combined Forces Command is launched under a South Korean commander
By the end of 2030, a reduction of USFK below 28,500 troops is confirmed by a U.S. government announcement or a report to Congress

By the end of 2030, the South Korean government formally pursues, through a government proposal or a bill, one of the following: extending active-duty service, introducing mandatory service for women, or switching to an all-volunteer force

forecasts.s: Democrats win the House in the U.S. midterms
forecasts.q: In the U.S. midterm elections on November 3, 2026, Democrats win at least 218 of the 435 House seats (based on each state's official results)

forecasts.s: Netanyahu returns as prime minister after Israel's election
forecasts.q: By February 28, 2027, Benjamin Netanyahu is prime minister of a new Israeli government that has won a Knesset vote of confidence (remaining prime minister of a caretaker government because no new government is formed does not count)
